name: facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spatial_engine/object_perception/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.load_visibility_dict: load a parquet file and convert it to a dictionary mapping scene image keys to point index lists
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.process_scene: process a single scene to compute object visibility across all valid images and return object-to-image mappings
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.process_split: process a train or val split by computing object visibility for all scenes and saving results to a pickle file
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_main: run the main function to compute object visibility for both train and val splits using configured paths
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.compute_object_visibility: compute the visibility percentage of each object in all valid images for a given scene using point-level visibility data

facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.merge_dimension: merge pickle files across subdirectories for a given split and dimension into a combined dictionary
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.merge_split: merge object coverage pickle files for height length and width dimensions and save results
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_merge_object_coverage: run the script to merge object coverage results for train and val splits
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.review_merge_dimension: review the merge_dimension function to understand how it parses directory names and loads pickle files
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.refactor_merge_split: refactor merge_split to support additional dimensions beyond height length and width

facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_object_coverage_finder: run the script to find minimal image combinations covering object height length and width dimensions
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_find_minimal_combinations: run find_minimal_combinations to get minimal image sets that cover a target dimension using BFS search
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_process_object: run process_object to compute minimal image combinations for height length and width of a single object
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_process_scene_for_coverage: run process_scene_for_coverage to compute object coverage results for all objects in a given scene
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_load_visibility_dict: run load_visibility_dict to load a parquet file and convert it to a key value dictionary

facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.build_lwh_qa_samples: build QA samples for object dimension estimation from merged pickle info files into JSONL format
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.convert_train_sample_to_eval_sample: convert a training format sample dict to evaluation format by extracting the first conversation text
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.build_train_and_val_datasets: build both training and validation datasets for object perception height length and width estimation
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.main: run the main entry point to build train and val datasets for single object perception
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.refactor_build_lwh_qa_samples: refactor build_lwh_qa_samples to support additional dimension types beyond height length and width
